comment: The expander's own process() only zeroes its outputs and lamps while it is unlinked (src/MaestroExp.hpp:139-155); when linked, the Maestro reads and writes this module's params, inputs, outputs and lights inside its own process(), in the same sample. The ten channel inputs and outputs are given no family, for the same reason as the Maestro's own: they carry gate, clock, audio or trigger signals, whatever is patched. The channel labels live on the Maestro, which keeps sixteen of them whether or not an expander is linked.
